page: Microsoft Azure D2ps_v5 is a general-purpose virtual machine based on the Ampere ARMv8 architecture running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is provisioned with 2 dedicated physical cores and 2 vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 3.0 GHz using the Neoverse-N1 microarchitecture. Memory allocation is set at 8.0 GB, establishing a standard 1:4 core-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The processor subsystem includes 64 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, 32 MB of L3 cache, and integrated hardware AES cryptographic acceleration. The instance does not include integrated GPUs or local instance storage, requiring remote storage solutions for persistent data.

Benchmark data reflects performance characteristics consistent with an entry-level dual-core ARM deployment. Single-threaded evaluation shows mid-range throughput, with stress-ng single-core achieving 1822.08 and single-threaded gzip compression processing 24.11 GB/sec. Multi-threaded and memory-intensive evaluations register in lower tiers, including a Geekbench multi-core score of 2004.0, a PassMark CPU score of 1586.72, and uncached large-block memory read bandwidth of 23.96 GB/sec. In application-focused metrics, the instance sustains 2.74 million Redis SET operations per second and 2.74 GB/sec of static web serving throughput.

The hardware configuration provides a power-efficient ARM profile with dedicated vCPU execution. Because the instance lacks local NVMe disks, advanced vector instruction sets, and higher core counts, it is not structured for heavy database indexing or large-scale batch compute. It is functionally aligned with lightweight microservices, basic web servers, ARM64 continuous integration pipelines, and small containerized workloads.
description: Microsoft Azure D2ps_v5 is an ARM64 general-purpose virtual machine powered by an Ampere ARMv8 Neoverse-N1 processor operating at 3.0 GHz. The instance delivers 2 dedicated physical cores, 2 vCPUs, and 8.0 GB of memory, maintaining a standard 1:4 compute-to-RAM ratio. It features hardware AES acceleration, a 32 MB L3 cache, contains no onboard GPU accelerators, and relies entirely on external storage due to the absence of local disk drives. In benchmark evaluations, the D2ps_v5 demonstrates average single-thread performance in synthetic stress tests and gzip compression, alongside lower-tier multi-threaded compute, memory bandwidth, and compilation scores. It achieves 2.74 million Redis SET operations per second and 2.74 GB/sec static web throughput. Providing power-efficient ARM architecture at low operational resource footprints, this server is best suited for entry-level container workloads, lightweight web serving, microservices, and development environments targeted at ARM64 software builds.
